name: Tactics Board
description: A top-down pitch with mown stripes and crisp white lines, red and blue numbered player tokens with soft shadows, dashed run arrows that draw themselves, a yellow ball path with numbered passes, and a running clock chip. Players move between real positions as a counter-attack unfolds pass by pass, defenders shift, the clock counts the seconds, and the finish gets a flash and a big word, then the takeaway.
best_use_cases: Explaining a sports play pass by pass
Showing movement and positioning on a pitch
Data-driven match analysis in a Short
style: Top-down pitch in real proportions with mown stripes and crisp white lines; red and blue numbered player tokens; dashed run arrows that draw themselves; yellow numbered ball path; running clock chip; Anton headline type.
